name: Gasthof Stauder
kurzbeschreibung:
**Inns Stauder in Tirol**

Welcome to **Inns Stauder**, a cozy and traditional guesthouse nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Just a short stroll from the lively center of **Innsbruck**, we offer warm hospitality and authentic Tyrolean charm.

Our rustic rooms invite you to relax after a day of exploring the stunning **Alps** or the vibrant city life. Savor our homemade **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Apfelstrudel**, and hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**—dishes that will make your taste buds dance.

Whether you're here for skiing, hiking, or simply unwinding, **Inns Stauder** is your perfect retreat. Come experience the warmth of **Tirol** with us!
